data.one_liner: Prebuilt video conference kit with UI and business logic for group voice/video chats.
data.what_it_does: Provides a prebuilt video conference component including business logic and UI for group voice/video chats, screen sharing, in-room messaging, member lists, and adaptive layouts. Enables adding video conferencing to an app in minutes.
use_when: You need to quickly prototype or integrate multi-user video conferences into your app.
You want a complete UI kit combined with meeting business logic.
avoid_when: You need to build a completely custom video calling UI from scratch using low-level stream primitives.
Your Android app cannot support `compileSdk` 37 or higher.
strengths: Includes both UI and business logic for rapid integration
Provides built-in features like screen sharing, member list, and live chat
weaknesses: Requires high compileSdk versions on Android (compileSdk 37+)
Strict dependency requirements on specific Flutter and Dart versions
data.setup_notes: Requires setting compileSdk to 37 or higher in the Android gradle file due to permission_handler constraints.
data.minimal_example:
ZegoUIKitPrebuiltVideoConference(
  appID: yourAppID,
  appSign: yourAppSign,
  userID: yourUserID,
  userName: yourUserName,
  conferenceID: yourConferenceID,
  config: ZegoUIKitPrebuiltVideoConferenceConfig(),
)
